- **[id 50]**: Lloyd's chickens produce 252 eggs/day, which is $252 / 12 = 21$ dozen eggs per day. At $2 per dozen, he makes $21 \times 2 = \$42$ per day. Over 7 days, he makes $42 \times 7 = \$294$.
- **[id 51]**: Tom sails for 3 hours (1 to 4 PM) at 10 mph, covering $3 \times 10 = 30$ miles. Traveling back at 6 mph takes $30 / 6 = 5$ hours.
- **[id 52]**: 30 comic books weigh $30 \times 0.25 = 7.5$ pounds. Uriah needs to remove an additional $15 - 7.5 = 7.5$ pounds. Each toy weighs 0.5 pounds, so he needs to remove $7.5 / 0.5 = 15$ toys.
- **[id 53]**: Thursday revenue is $(6 \times 60) + (4 \times 40) = 360 + 160 = \$520$. Friday revenue is $12 \times 40 = \$480$. The difference is $520 - 480 = \$40$.
- **[id 54]**: The family has 7 adopted kittens, Patchy had $3 \times 7 = 21$ kittens, and Trixie had 12 kittens. Total kittens = $7 + 21 + 12 = 40$.
- **[id 55]**: Jean has $30 - 2 = 28$ lollipops left. With 2 per bag, Jean can fill $28 / 2 = 14$ bags.
- **[id 56]**: Each trip costs $\$7 + \$7 = \$14$. With $\$42$, Peter can go $42 / 14 = 3$ times.
- **[id 57]**: Available weight capacity is $5000 - 3755 = 1245$ pounds. Maximum boxes = $1245 / 15 = 83$.
- **[id 58]**: 25% fee on $\$40$ is $\$10$. Total price = $40 + 10 + 3 + 4 = \$57$.
- **[id 59]**: Raspberries in clusters = $6 \times 20 = 120$. Total raspberries = $120 + 67 = 187$.
